title: PyTex Measured SAED Pattern
description: A measured selected-area electron diffraction pattern as a list of picked spot positions plus the calibration needed to turn them into reciprocal-space vectors. This file is the reproducibility boundary of pytex.diffraction.solving: a pattern solved from a committed file gives the same answer on any machine, whether the spots were clicked interactively or typed by hand. The transmitted beam is not a spot -- it is the calibration's centre, and every position is taken relative to it.

name.description: Identifier for the pattern, carried into the solution report.

spots.description: Picked spots, in the calibration's coordinate units. At least two are required: two non-collinear reflections are what fix a zone axis.

units.description: What the spot coordinates are. Pixel coordinates need pixel_size_mm; pixels and millimetres both need a camera constant, given directly or as camera_length_mm with beam_energy_kev. Reciprocal-angstrom coordinates need no further calibration.

centre.description: Transmitted-beam position in the same units as the spot coordinates, subtracted before anything else. Omit for a pattern already measured relative to the beam.

camera_constant_mm_angstrom.description: L*lambda, relating detector radius to |g| through r = (L*lambda) |g|.

camera_length_mm.description: Effective camera length; combined with beam_energy_kev it yields the camera constant.

beam_energy_kev.description: Accelerating voltage, used for the relativistic electron wavelength.

pixel_size_mm.description: Detector pixel pitch. Required when units are px.

intensity.description: Optional measured intensity. The solver never uses it -- geometry alone decides an indexing -- but it is carried through for plotting and record-keeping.

label.description: Optional operator label for the spot, e.g. 'A'.
